title: Khara's war
topic: Aranya Kanda — Khara and Dushana fall
disclaimer: Crowd/war simplified. Rama identity must match ep 1. Not a video-game arena.
story_goal: She brings Khara–Dushana; Rama fights; the rakshasa force falls.
gate: Battlefield location lock + crowd rule; Rama still matches ep 1.
narrative_summary: Wounded Surpanakha brings Khara. Rama kills the host. Dust, not glory.

fact_checks.claim: Khara and Dushana attack Rama and die.

panels.scene_description: Wounded Surpanakha before Khara. Midface wound mandatory. She points north toward the ashram.
panels.dialogue: SURPANAKHA: Two men. A woman. They cut me like a joke.

shot_card.camera: medium, her ruined face toward us, Khara mass behind
shot_card.lighting: camp fire leftover, then cut to morning
shot_card.blocking: she is small against his armor

panels.scene_description: Khara and Dushana distinct helmets. Host assembling on the field.
panels.dialogue: KHARA: Then we unmake the joke.

shot_card.camera: wide field lock — dust ground, banners
shot_card.blocking: two commanders, crowd as texture not portraits
shot_card.dramatic_purpose: Crowd rule: no individual extras as leads.

panels.scene_description: Rama on the field. Exile cloth, bow, same face as ep01. Dust on him already.
panels.caption: He did not come as a god. He came as the man who lives there.

shot_card.camera: full figure, no heroic low-angle chrome

panels.scene_description: First exchange: arrow vs mace space. Not a blur of extra arms.
panels.dialogue: KHARA: Hide behind dharma if it helps you die.

panels.scene_description: Lakshmana takes Dushana's side of the field. Wrap visible.

shot_card.blocking: pair fight, not a clone of Rama's pose
shot_card.dramatic_purpose: Brother is not a second Rama sprite.

panels.scene_description: Khara falls. Keep it short. Dust, not fountain.
panels.caption: The commander learns the arrow's name too late.

shot_card.camera: medium, Khara down, Rama still standing in exile cloth

panels.scene_description: She watches the field die. Wound, dust, no tears-for-beauty.
panels.caption: She has one brother left who can make a country move.

shot_card.camera: close three-quarter wounded face, field bokeh

panels.scene_description: Aftermath: banners down. Two brothers. No victory speech.
panels.dialogue: RAMA: She will not stop at this dust.
